cards.ex: The singer's command performance for the queen was the highlight of her career.
cards.exUz: Qo'shiqchining malika uchun maxsus buyurtma spektakli uning faoliyatidagi eng yuqori nuqta bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori martabali shaxs uchun maxsus uyushtirilgan spektakl yoki konsert.

cards.ex: The play included a beautiful musical interlude to allow for a scene change.
cards.exUz: Sahna o'zgarishi uchun pyesada chiroyli musiqiy tanaffus kiritilgan.
cards.uzDef: Spektakl yoki tadbir davomidagi qisqa musiqa qismi.

cards.ex: The festival's success was due to the orchestrated effort of many volunteers.
cards.exUz: Festivalning muvaffaqiyati ko'plab ko'ngillilarning uyushtirilgan harakatlari tufayli bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun rejalashtirilgan harakat.

cards.ex: The young pianist took center stage and wowed the audience.
cards.exUz: Yosh pianist markazga chiqdi va tomoshabinlarni hayratga soldi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat markazida bo'lmoq yoki eng muhim rol o'ynamoq.

cards.ex: After performing serious dramas for years, she wanted a change of pace and tried comedy.
cards.exUz: Uzoq yillar davomida jiddiy dramalarda rol o'ynaganidan so'ng, u ritmni o'zgartirishni xohladi va komediyaga o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan farqliroq, yangicha ish yoki faoliyat.

cards.ex: The comedian's jokes were so funny that he brought the house down.
cards.exUz: Komikning hazillari shu qadar kulgili ediki, u zalni olqishlarga ko'tardi.
cards.uzDef: Tomoshabinlarni juda xursand qilmoq, olqishlarga sazovor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: After such an amazing performance, they're a tough act to follow.
cards.exUz: Bunday ajoyib ijrodan keyin ularga yetishish qiyin vazifa.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa birovning muvaffaqiyatidan keyin erishish qiyin bo'lgan vazifa.

cards.ex: The band is often remembered as a one-hit wonder.
cards.exUz: Guruh ko'pincha faqat bitta qo'shiq yulduzi sifatida eslanadi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat bitta mashhur qo'shiq bilan tanilgan qo'shiqchi yoki guruh.

cards.ex: The singer's heartfelt lyrics struck a chord with the audience.
cards.exUz: Qo'shiqchining samimiy so'zlari tomoshabinlarga ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir his-tuyg'ulariga yoki fikrlariga mos kelmoq, ta'sir o'tkazmoq.

cards.ex: The successful opening act set the stage for a great concert.
cards.exUz: Muvaffaqiyatli kirish qismi ajoyib konsert uchun sharoit yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi hodisa yoki vaziyat uchun sharoit yaratmoq.

cards.ex: The band is really in tune with their audience.
cards.exUz: Guruh tomoshabinlar bilan haqiqatan ham mos keladi.
cards.uzDef: Bilan kelishmoq, bir xil fikrda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The finale of the ballet was a real showstopper; everyone was on their feet.
cards.exUz: Baletning finali haqiqiy tomoshabin hayratlantiruvchi edi; hamma o'rnidan turdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir tomoshadagi eng yaxshi, hayratlanarli chiqish yoki qismi.

cards.ex: I'm tired of playing second fiddle to my more famous brother.
cards.exUz: Men mashhur akamga nisbatan ikkinchi rolda o'ynashdan charchadim.
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir kamroq muhim rol o'ynamoq yoki yordamchi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: When she said she'd handle the negotiations, that was music to my ears.
cards.exUz: U muzokaralarni hal qilishini aytganda, bu mening quloqlarimga yoqimli musiqa edi.
cards.uzDef: Eshitish juda yoqimli bo'lgan xabar yoki so'zlar.

cards.ex: I refuse to dance to their tune; I'll make my own decisions.
cards.exUz: Men ularning kuylariga raqsga tushishdan bosh tortaman; o'zim qaror qabul qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir buyruqlari bo'yicha yoki xohishlariga ko'ra harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The band's success was just a flash in the pan; they disappeared after one album.
cards.exUz: Guruhning muvaffaqiyati faqat tez so'nadi; ular bir albomdan keyin yo'q bo'lib ketishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa muddatli muvaffaqiyat, tezda unutiladigan hodisa.

cards.ex: He always tries to steal the limelight at family gatherings.
cards.exUz: U har doim oilaviy yig'inlarda diqqatni o'g'irlashga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning diqqatini o'ziga qaratmoq, ulardan ustun kelmoq.

cards.ex: The new play was a roaring success, selling out every night.
cards.exUz: Yangi pyesa juda katta muvaffaqiyatga erishdi, har kecha chiptalar sotilib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta va kutilganidan ham yuqori darajadagi muvaffaqiyat.

cards.ex: We need to fine-tune the marketing campaign before we launch it.
cards.exUz: Biz marketing kampaniyasini ishga tushirishdan oldin uni sozlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni yaxshilash uchun kichik o'zgarishlar kiritmoq.

cards.ex: We don't have a plan yet; we'll just play it by ear.
cards.exUz: Bizda hali reja yo'q; shunchaki holatga qarab ish tutamiz.
cards.uzDef: Rejaga ega bo'lmasdan, vaziyatga qarab harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: She carefully orchestrated the surprise party.
cards.exUz: U sirli ziyofatni ehtiyotkorlik bilan tashkillashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Murakkab vazifani puxta rejalashtirib, boshqarmoq.

cards.ex: The algorithm has been fine-tuned to improve its accuracy.
cards.exUz: Algoritm aniqligini oshirish uchun mukammallashtirildi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik o'zgarishlar kiritish orqali yanada yaxshiroq qilingan.

cards.ex: The campaign was a carefully orchestrated attempt to win votes.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya ovoz yig'ish uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan tashkillashtirilgan urinish edi.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan va muvaffaqiyatli amalga oshirilgan.

cards.ex: The band played to a sell-out performance every night of their tour.
cards.exUz: Guruh gastrol safarining har bir kechasida to'la zalda o'ynadi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha chiptalar sotilgan tomosha yoki kontsert.
